question_summary: Learning ancestors' history versus focusing on present and future family
practice_prompt:
Researching one's ancestors can reveal useful lessons about family history. Others believe attention is better directed towards the needs of present and future generations.

Discuss both views and give your own opinion.

question_summary: History helps understand present versus provides little value
practice_prompt:
Some believe historical study gives essential insight into current events. Others regard the past as less useful than knowledge about contemporary problems.

Discuss both views and give your own opinion.

question_summary: Subsidising produce versus taxing unhealthy food to improve diets
practice_prompt:
Poor diets can be addressed by reducing the cost of healthy food or making unhealthy products more expensive. Some support subsidies for nutritious products, while others prefer taxes on less healthy food.

Discuss both views and give your own opinion.

question_summary: Achievement of life goals mainly determined by luck
practice_prompt:
People differ greatly in their achievements despite having similar opportunities. Some argue that luck is the main factor determining whether someone reaches their goals.

To what extent do you agree or disagree?

question_summary: Hard work versus money and looks for success
practice_prompt:
Some believe determination and effort are the foundations of success. Others argue that money, social status and appearance matter more in modern society.

Discuss both views and give your own opinion.

question_summary: Increasing prices of sugary foods and drinks to reduce consumption
practice_prompt:
Sugary drinks and heavily sweetened foods can contribute to poor health. Some believe making these products more expensive would encourage healthier choices.

To what extent do you agree or disagree?

question_summary: Talent TV contests discover ability versus entertainment only
practice_prompt:
Televised competitions give amateur performers public exposure. Some see them as a way to discover genuine talent, whereas others regard them as entertainment created mainly to attract viewers.

Discuss both views and give your own opinion.

question_summary: Tax revenue for health services versus other public uses
practice_prompt:
Governments must divide tax revenue between healthcare and other public services. Some believe health services should receive the largest share, while others prioritise different needs.

Discuss both views and give your own opinion.

question_summary: Teachers outweigh parents in child's development after school begins
practice_prompt:
Once children begin school, they spend many hours with teachers. Some believe educators then have a stronger influence on children's development than their parents do.

To what extent do you agree or disagree?

question_summary: Teachers teaching ethics versus academic instruction
practice_prompt:
Some believe teachers should provide moral guidance alongside their subjects. Others argue that schools should focus on academic knowledge and leave personal values to families.

Discuss both views and give your own opinion.

question_summary: Team sports versus individual sports benefits
practice_prompt:
Team sports require cooperation, while individual sports develop independent decision-making and self-reliance. People disagree about which kind is more beneficial.

Discuss both views and give your own opinion.

question_summary: Technology reduces crime versus causes more crime
practice_prompt:
New technologies can help police detect offences, but they can also create opportunities for cybercrime and fraud. Some think technological progress reduces crime, whereas others believe it increases it.

Discuss both views and give your own opinion.

question_summary: Technology brings benefits or creates problems
practice_prompt:
Technology offers convenience and economic opportunities, yet it can also create new social problems. Some consider its overall influence beneficial, while others are more concerned about its drawbacks.

Discuss both views and give your own opinion.

question_summary: Eliminating technology could simplify increasingly complex lives
practice_prompt:
Modern life depends on complicated digital services and devices. Some argue that reducing our use of technology would make daily life simpler and more satisfying.

To what extent do you agree or disagree?

question_summary: Technology lowers versus enables criminal activity
practice_prompt:
Some believe digital innovations help prevent and investigate crimes. Others argue that criminals use the same innovations to commit offences more easily.

Discuss both views and give your own opinion.

question_summary: Better crime prevention technology will reduce crime rates
practice_prompt:
Advanced surveillance and crime-detection systems are increasingly available. Some believe these innovations will lead to a substantial fall in crime.

To what extent do you agree or disagree?

question_summary: People spending longer periods away from families
practice_prompt:
Working and studying commitments can keep people away from their families for extended periods.

Why are people spending more time apart from close relatives? What effects can this have on individuals and families?
task_requirements: ["explain causes", "explain effects on people and families"]
task_requirements_v2: ["explain causes", "explain effects on people and families"]

question_summary: Insufficient time to care for elderly relatives
practice_prompt:
In some countries, working adults find it increasingly difficult to spend enough time caring for elderly relatives.

What factors are making family care harder, and how could older people receive better support?

question_summary: Developing economies expand tourism sectors
practice_prompt:
More developing countries are investing in tourism to generate income and employment.

Why are developing countries investing more heavily in tourism? What benefits could local communities gain from this growth?

question_summary: Growing tourism sectors in developing economies
practice_prompt:
Tourism is becoming an important part of the economy in a growing number of lower-income countries.

What explains the expansion of tourism in lower-income countries? Is this a positive or negative development?

question_summary: Traditional ways of life are no longer worth keeping
practice_prompt:
Global communication and modern lifestyles are changing customs passed down through generations. Some believe preserving old ways of life is no longer worthwhile.

To what extent do you agree or disagree?

question_summary: Old customs and traditions no longer worth preserving
practice_prompt:
Certain traditional customs may appear less relevant as societies change. Some argue that communities should abandon practices that belong to the past.

To what extent do you agree or disagree?

question_summary: Pollution from goods and people transport: governments versus individuals responsible
practice_prompt:
Transporting goods and passengers creates pollution. Some believe governments must lead efforts to reduce these emissions, while others argue that individuals should change their travel and purchasing habits.

Discuss both views and give your own opinion.

question_summary: Government faster public transport investment versus cost and environmental priorities
practice_prompt:
Fast public transport can reduce journey times but requires large infrastructure projects. Some support greater investment, while others prefer spending on more immediate environmental and social priorities.

Discuss both views and give your own opinion.

question_summary: Fast cheap transportation versus good technology for international business
practice_prompt:
International businesses depend on moving goods efficiently and communicating across borders. Some emphasise affordable, fast transport, while others believe digital technology is more important.

Discuss both views and give your own opinion.

question_summary: Planting trees in vacant city spaces rather than housing
practice_prompt:
City authorities must decide whether unused urban land should be developed for housing or turned into green spaces. Some argue that planting trees should be the priority.

To what extent do you agree or disagree?

question_summary: Children's TV behaviour affected by content versus screen hours
practice_prompt:
Some believe the programmes children watch determine much of their television-related behaviour. Others think the total time spent watching matters more than the content.

Discuss both views and give your own opinion.

question_summary: TV content versus viewing duration affects child behaviour
practice_prompt:
Parents often worry about children's television habits. Some believe the material shown on screen has the greatest influence on behaviour, while others focus on how long children watch.

Discuss both views and give your own opinion.

question_summary: Better unemployed than working in a disliked job
practice_prompt:
A job can provide financial stability but little personal satisfaction. Some believe being unemployed is preferable to working in a position one strongly dislikes.

To what extent do you agree or disagree?

question_summary: Laws too difficult for police to enforce
practice_prompt:
Police officers may struggle to enforce laws that are highly complicated or difficult for the public to understand.

Why do some laws become difficult to enforce, and what changes could improve compliance?

question_summary: Persisting with harmful health behaviour despite education
practice_prompt:
Even when people know that smoking, poor eating habits or inactivity can harm them, some continue these behaviours.

Why do harmful health habits persist despite awareness campaigns, and how could people be encouraged to change?

question_summary: Universities offering practical courses rather than humanities
practice_prompt:
Universities have limited places and funding. Some believe they should prioritise employment-focused courses over subjects such as literature, philosophy and history.

To what extent do you agree or disagree?

question_summary: Competition for university admission increasing
practice_prompt:
In some countries, competition for university places is becoming increasingly intense.

What factors are driving this increased competition? Is the trend beneficial or harmful overall?

question_summary: Difficulty studying at university versus school
practice_prompt:
Students entering university may find independent study and academic expectations more demanding than school.

What creates these difficulties, and what could universities do to support new students?

question_summary: College education versus immediate employment for career success
practice_prompt:
Some believe a university degree is the most reliable route to a rewarding career. Others argue that young adults learn more useful skills by starting full-time work immediately after school.

Discuss both views and give your own opinion.

question_summary: University degrees versus immediate work experience
practice_prompt:
University education provides formal qualifications, whereas employment straight after school offers early practical experience. People disagree about which route leads to better career prospects.

Discuss both views and give your own opinion.

question_summary: Tourism to pristine unexplored natural destinations
practice_prompt:
Travel companies are offering trips to natural places that have previously received few tourists.

What advantages and disadvantages could this type of tourism bring to visitors and the areas concerned?

question_summary: City centres with days banning private motor vehicles
practice_prompt:
Some cities close central streets to privately owned cars on particular days while continuing to permit public transport and essential vehicles.

Do the advantages of these restrictions outweigh the disadvantages?

question_summary: High-density vertical cities versus low-rise horizontal towns
practice_prompt:
Growing cities can accommodate residents in tall apartment buildings or expand outwards with lower-rise housing. Some favour compact vertical development, while others prefer more spacious low-rise communities.

Discuss both views and give your own opinion.

question_summary: Violent films and games should be banned or accepted
practice_prompt:
Films and electronic games sometimes contain extreme violence. Some favour banning such material, while others believe adults should be free to choose it as entertainment.

Discuss both views and give your own opinion.

question_summary: Violent games and films harmful versus harmless entertainment
practice_prompt:
Some argue that violent entertainment encourages aggression, whereas others believe fictional violence is largely harmless to viewers and players.

Discuss both views and give your own opinion.

question_summary: Online cultural history means physical museums are unnecessary
practice_prompt:
Museums allow visitors to experience objects and artefacts directly. Some argue that online collections now provide sufficient access to cultural history, making physical museums unnecessary.

To what extent do you agree or disagree?

question_summary: Fund vocational skills rather than university programmes
practice_prompt:
Governments can support vocational training in trades and technical skills or spend more on traditional university programmes. Some argue that practical job training deserves priority.

To what extent do you agree or disagree?

question_summary: Additional wealth in already rich country does not improve happiness
practice_prompt:
In wealthy countries, average incomes may continue to rise even after most basic needs have been met. Some argue that additional national wealth then contributes little to people's happiness.

To what extent do you agree or disagree?

question_summary: Great wealth matters chiefly because it enables generosity
practice_prompt:
People may seek financial success for personal comfort or to support others. Some believe the greatest value of being rich is the opportunity to share money with people in need.

To what extent do you agree or disagree?

question_summary: Western fashions replacing traditional clothing
practice_prompt:
In many places, Western-style clothing is becoming more popular than garments associated with local traditions.

Why are people increasingly choosing Western-style clothing? Is this a positive or negative cultural development?

question_summary: Wildlife decline is irreversible versus improvements still possible
practice_prompt:
Wild animal populations have declined in many regions. Some believe the damage cannot be reversed, while others argue that conservation efforts can still improve the situation.

Discuss both views and give your own opinion.

question_summary: Compulsory percentage of leadership positions reserved for women
practice_prompt:
Some propose requiring large organisations to reserve a minimum proportion of senior management positions for women to improve representation.

To what extent do you agree or disagree?

question_summary: Challenges of achieving work-life balance
practice_prompt:
Workers often struggle to divide their time between their employment and personal responsibilities.

What problems can an unhealthy work-life balance create, and what could employers and individuals do to improve it?

question_summary: People work hard only for money
practice_prompt:
People work hard for many reasons, including income, personal growth and a sense of purpose. Some believe earning money is the only significant motivation.

To what extent do you agree or disagree?

question_summary: Social lives at work versus outside workplace
practice_prompt:
Some people build their strongest social relationships at work, while others prefer to keep professional and personal friendships separate.

Discuss both views and give your own opinion.

question_summary: Continuing employment into old age
practice_prompt:
In countries with longer life expectancy, more people wish to remain employed beyond traditional retirement age. Some believe this should be encouraged.

To what extent do you agree or disagree?

question_summary: Youths experiencing less happiness despite greater health and wealth
practice_prompt:
In some societies, young people enjoy better health and greater material comfort than earlier generations, yet many report lower levels of happiness.

What might explain this situation, and what could be done to improve young people's wellbeing?

question_summary: Rural youth move to cities for education and work
practice_prompt:
Young adults often leave rural communities to pursue education or employment in major cities.

Why are young people leaving rural communities for cities? Do the advantages of this migration outweigh the disadvantages?

question_summary: Younger leaders better than older company executives
practice_prompt:
A younger manager may bring new ideas, while an older manager may offer long experience. Some argue that businesses are better led by younger people.

To what extent do you agree or disagree?

question_summary: Increased juvenile crime and suitable punishment for teenagers
practice_prompt:
Some countries are experiencing an increase in crimes committed by teenagers.

What factors may contribute to an increase in juvenile offending? How should the justice system punish teenagers who commit crimes?

question_summary: Juvenile serious offenders should receive same punishments as adults
practice_prompt:
Some teenagers commit serious offences that cause substantial harm. Some argue that young offenders should face the same punishments as adults who commit equivalent crimes.

To what extent do you agree or disagree?

question_summary: Youth unemployment affects people and society
practice_prompt:
Young adults in some regions struggle to find stable employment, even after completing their education.

What problems can youth unemployment create for individuals and society, and what measures could reduce it?
